messages.content: Read this note: The museum opens on Tuesday at 10 AM and closes at 6 PM. On Thursday it stays open until 8 PM. What time does it close on Thursday? Answer with just the time.
A shop starts with 23 notebooks, sells 7 and receives 12 more. How many notebooks does it have? Reply with only the number.
Of copper, wood, and iron, which material is NOT a metal? Reply with one word.
Convert 2.5 kilometers to meters. Reply with only the number.
Sort these numbers in ascending order: 17, -2, 8, 0. Reply with just the sorted list.
Remember that the project code is ORCHID.
The project code is ORCHID.
We also considered LILY, but did not select it. What is the project code? Reply with just the code.

What does this Python code print?
x = [1, 2, 3, 4]
print(x[1:3])
Reply with only the printed value.
A Python function should include every integer from 1 through n. Its current loop is range(1, n). Give only the corrected range expression.
Return only a JSON object with exactly these fields: name is Mira and count is the integer 3. Do not use a Markdown code fence.
Ava left Boston on Monday and arrived in Berlin on Tuesday. Which city did she leave, and on which day? Reply in the format city, day.
In two short sentences, explain why Earth has seasons. Mention the cause and how it changes sunlight. Avoid a list.
Five printers print five pages in five minutes. At the same rate, how many minutes do 100 printers need to print 100 pages? Reply with only the number.
Use only this passage: Eva is a baker who lives in Oslo. Her bakery opens at 7 AM. What is Eva's birthday? Say if the passage does not tell you.
Write a friendly reminder to a colleague to send the slides by Friday. Use at most 35 words and include the word Friday. Do not use the word urgent.
Translate to English, with no explanation: Der Zug fährt um acht Uhr ab.
Si llueve, Marta lleva un paraguas. Hoy llueve. ¿Qué lleva Marta? Responde en español con una frase corta.
La réunion prévue lundi est reportée à mercredi. Quel jour aura lieu la réunion ? Répondez en français, en un mot.
小明有九个苹果，又买了三个苹果。现在他一共有几个苹果？只回答数字。
Translate "The library is closed today" into Japanese. Reply only in Japanese.

review: Check that the Japanese says the library is closed today, without language mixing.

How many blue circles are in the image? Reply with only the number.
What shape is to the left of the blue circle? Reply with its color and shape.
Transcribe the printed words in this image. Reply with only the text.
Which bar is tallest: A, B, or C? Reply with only its letter.
